svg.title: Each package imports only what it needs.
svg.text: The record, the rules, the operations
One work file in, one result file out, for any kind of work its image holds
File formats, port interfaces, shared types. Imports nothing from ROBIN.
Worker images: one for each runtime family
The release names each model's family. The launcher starts each task in that family's image. An image refuses a work file for a model or kind of work that it does not hold.
Today every base model shares it
